DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ごみの出し方についての相談をお考えですか。何がわからないか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you thinking of asking about putting out rubbish? Please tell me what you are unsure about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋に届いた案内と建物の掲示で、収集日の書き方が違います。両方を見てもらう相談はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅の案内と集合住宅掲示の収集日の書き方が違い両方を見てもらいたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The notice delivered to my flat and the building notice describe the collection days differently. Can I ask someone to look at both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the collection days are written differently on the notice at home and the apartment building notice, and ask to have both checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の発行元と掲示の内容を、担当へ確認しましょう。届いた案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us ask the person in charge about who issued the notice and what the building notice says. Did you bring the notice you received?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内の紙は持っています。建物の掲示は写真に撮りましたが、これも参考になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内紙を持参し掲示の写真も参考になるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the paper notice. I took a photo of the building notice too. Would that also be useful?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought the paper notice and ask whether the photo of the building notice would also be useful. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、違いを説明する材料になります。住所によって確認する情報もあるので、担当へ住所も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, it will help explain the difference. Some information needs checking according to your address, so please give the person in charge your address too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所も伝えます。平日は昼休みしか時間がないので、電話で相談できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所も伝えると答え昼休みに電話相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will give them my address too. On weekdays I only have my lunch break free, so I would like to know whether I can consult them by phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will also provide your address and ask whether a telephone consultation during your lunch break is possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の電話受付時間を確認する必要があります。ご希望の時間と、相談したい内容をこちらで整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need to check the department's telephone hours. Let us note your preferred time and what you want to ask about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十二時半ごろを希望します。長く話せない場合は、別の日の相談を予約できるかも聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 十二時半の希望と長時間話せない場合の別日予約を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would prefer around twelve thirty. If there is not enough time for a long conversation, please also ask whether I can book a consultation for another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check your preference for twelve thirty and whether another day's appointment is possible if you cannot talk for long. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 十二時半の電話相談と、別日の予約の可否を担当へ確認します。回答を受ける連絡先も残していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will ask the person in charge about a twelve-thirty telephone consultation and whether an appointment on another day is possible. Could you leave contact details for their reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯番号を記入します。電話できる時間か予約方法の回答を受けてから、案内と掲示の違いを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯番号を書き受付時間か予約方法の回答後に相違点を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write down my mobile number. After I hear what times I can call or how to make an appointment, I will consult them about the difference between the two notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write your mobile number and discuss the discrepancy after receiving the answer about telephone hours or booking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。回答の連絡をお待ちください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please wait for us to contact you with the answer. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計はお済みですね。書類について聞きたいことがあると伺いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have finished paying, haven't you? I understand you have a question about a document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場からこの用紙を渡されました。受診した日を記入してもらいたいのですが、ここでお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場の用紙を示し受診日記入を依頼できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My workplace gave me this form. I would like the date of my medical visit entered on it. Can I request that here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the workplace form and ask whether you can request that the date of your visit be entered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拝見します。病院側が記入する欄のある用紙ですね。記入できる書類か、書類の担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see. This form has a section for the hospital to fill in. Let us check with the documents staff whether we can complete it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用紙には医師の署名の欄もあります。看護師さんに書いていただく物ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 医師署名欄を読み看護師が記入する物ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The form also has a space for a doctor's signature. So it is not something for a nurse to fill in, is it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Look at the doctor's signature space and confirm that this is not a document for a nurse to complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この署名欄については医師への確認が必要です。申込方法は受付の書類担当で聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, we need to check with a doctor about that signature space. You can ask the documents staff at reception how to apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の用紙を預ける前に、料金と完成までの日数を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 職場用紙を預ける前に料金と完成日数を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before I leave my company's form with you, could you tell me the fee and how many days it will take to complete?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you would like to know the fee and completion time before leaving the workplace form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二点も担当へ尋ねてください。会社に提出する期限は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask the person in charge about those two points as well. Has your company set a submission deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の月曜日です。間に合わなければ、先に領収書を出してよいか職場へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来週月曜の提出期限と間に合わなければ領収書でよいか職場へ確認する案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is next Monday. If it will not be ready in time, I would like to ask my workplace whether I can submit the receipt first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give next Monday's deadline and explain your plan to ask the workplace whether a receipt is acceptable first if the form will not be ready. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 職場で受け付ける書類は職場へ確認してください。病院の担当には提出期限を伝え、受け取れる見込みを聞きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with your workplace which documents they accept. Tell our documents staff the submission deadline and ask when you can expect to receive the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類担当へ用紙と期限を見せて、料金と日数を聞きます。間に合わない場合は、領収書でよいか職場に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当へ用紙と期限を示して費用と日数を聞き、間に合わない場合は職場へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the documents staff the form and deadline, and ask about the fee and number of days. If it will not be ready in time, I will ask my workplace whether the receipt will do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the staff the form and deadline, ask the cost and number of days, and check with work if it cannot be completed in time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙と領収書をなくさないようお持ちください。お大事になさってください、それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the form and receipt with you so you do not lose them. Take care of yourself. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物の届け出ですね。何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to report something lost. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 読書用の眼鏡を入れたケースです。川沿いのベンチで本を読んだあと、かばんにないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 川沿いのベンチで読書後に眼鏡ケースがかばんにないと気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a case containing my reading glasses. After reading on a bench by the river, I noticed it was not in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that after reading on a riverside bench, you noticed your glasses case was missing from your bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ベンチで使ったのは何時ごろですか。ケースの見た目も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around what time did you use them on the bench? Please describe the case as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方五時ごろです。ケースは硬い茶色の物で、ふたに銀色の小さな葉の模様があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日十七時ごろと硬い茶色のケースの銀色の葉模様を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around five yesterday evening. It is a hard brown case with a small silver leaf pattern on the lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give yesterday around five p.m. and describe the hard brown case with its silver leaf pattern. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中の眼鏡にも、見分けられる特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do the glasses inside also have any distinguishing features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤い細いフレームで、右のつるの内側に白いテープを貼っています。ケースには名前を書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 眼鏡の赤い細いフレームと右つるの白いテープと無記名を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: They have a thin red frame, with white tape inside the right arm. I have not written my name on the case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the thin red frame, white tape on the right arm, and the absence of a name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴を記録します。ベンチの後に立ち寄った場所も、わかる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record those features. Please also tell me, as far as you remember, where you stopped after leaving the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近くの自動販売機で飲み物を買って、そのまま家へ歩きました。途中ではかばんを開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベンチ後の自販機と帰宅経路と途中ではかばんを開けていないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I bought a drink from a nearby vending machine and walked straight home. I did not open my bag on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the vending machine stop after the bench and the walk home, and say you did not open your bag on the way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。連絡先はこちらへ記入してください。見つかったときの受取方法は、連絡の際にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please write your contact details here. If it is found, we will explain how to collect it when we contact you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自宅の電話番号を書きます。携帯は持っていないので、昼間つながらなければ夕方に連絡していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅番号を記入し携帯がなく昼不在の場合は夕方連絡を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my home phone number. I do not have a mobile, so if you cannot reach me during the day, please call in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write your home number and request an evening call if you cannot be reached during the day, as you have no mobile. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望も記録します。届け出の控えをお受け取りください。それでは、気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record that preference too. Please take this copy of your report. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。再配達についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a missed-delivery notice. Is this about arranging redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、私が申し込もうとしたら、同居人も手続きをしたかもしれないと言いました。二重になるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居人が再配達を申し込んだ可能性があり二重申込を心配していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I was about to apply, my housemate said they might already have done it. I am worried about making a duplicate request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your housemate may have requested redelivery and that you are worried about duplicate requests. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、同居人に申し込みを済ませたか確かめるとよいですね。受付完了の画面や日時の控えはあるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It would be best first to check whether your housemate completed the request. Might they have a confirmation screen or a note of the date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同居人はいま仕事中で、まだ聞けません。不在票の番号から、こちらでも確認をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居人に今確認できず不在票番号で窓口でも確認できるか頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My housemate is at work now, so I cannot ask yet. Could you also check here using the number on the missed-delivery notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot ask your housemate now and request a check at the counter using the notice number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が確認できる内容をお調べします。宛名と住所を、不在票と照合させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will find out what the person in charge can check. Please let me match the addressee and address against the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物は私宛てで、住所はこちらです。いまは新しく申し込まず、確認の結果を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分宛ての荷物と住所を示し新たな申込をせず結果を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The parcel is addressed to me, and this is the address. I will wait for the result without making a new request now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that the parcel is for you and give the address; say you will wait for the result without applying again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。再配達の希望はありますか。現在の受付状況を調べた後に、必要な手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Do you have a preferred redelivery time? Once we check the current request status, we will explain any necessary procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あさっての午前中を希望します。すでに別の日時で申し込んでいたら、変更できるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: あさって午前希望と既存申込日時の変更可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would prefer the morning of the day after tomorrow. If a different time has already been requested, I would also like to ask whether it can be changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the morning of the day after tomorrow as your preference and ask whether an existing requested date and time can be changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 希望日時と変更の相談も担当へ伝えます。確認には少し時間がかかりますので、こちらでお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also tell the person in charge your preferred time and question about changing it. The check will take a little time. Could you wait here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。確認後、同居人にも結果を伝えて、一人だけが必要な手続きをするようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口で待ち確認結果を同居人へ伝え必要手続きを一人にまとめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here. After the check, I will tell my housemate the result and make sure only one of us completes any necessary procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait at the counter, tell your housemate the result, and have only one person handle the required procedure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。担当へ確認してきますので、その票をお持ちのままお待ちください。それでは一度失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I will go and check with the person in charge. Please keep the notice with you while you wait. Excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードをなくされたとのことですが、どのカードか確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You said you lost a card. Have you confirmed which card it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布に二枚入れていましたが、一枚しかありません。残っているのはクレジットカードで、キャッシュカードが見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布の二枚中残った物がクレジットカードでキャッシュカードがないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I had two cards in my wallet, but now there is only one. The remaining one is my credit card; I cannot find my bank cash card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that of the two cards in your wallet the credit card remains, but the bank cash card is missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの銀行のキャッシュカードでしょうか。発行元がわかる通帳などはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it this bank's cash card? Do you have a passbook or something showing the issuing bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この通帳と同じ銀行のカードです。昨夜、お金を引き出してから戻したか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳と同じ発行銀行のカードで昨夜出金後の収納を覚えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a card from the same bank as this passbook. I cannot remember whether I put it back after withdrawing money last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it was issued by the bank on the passbook and you cannot remember putting it away after last night's withdrawal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紛失の担当が本人確認をして停止について対応します。ほかのカードの発行元とは、用件を分けてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The lost-card staff will verify your identity and handle blocking it. Please discuss any matters concerning other card issuers separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残っているクレジットカードの停止ではなく、この銀行のキャッシュカードの停止を先にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残ったクレジットカードではなく該当銀行のキャッシュカードを停止したいと明確に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please first block this bank's cash card, rather than the credit card that I still have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clearly request that the missing cash card from this bank be blocked, rather than the remaining credit card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その用件を担当へ伝えます。本人確認書類はお持ちですか。暗証番号はここで言わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that request to the person in charge. Have you brought identification? Please do not say your PIN here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 運転免許証があります。停止のあと、再発行まで現金を引き出す方法も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 免許証を持参し停止後再発行までの現金引出し方法も相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my driving licence. After the card is blocked, I would also like to ask how to withdraw cash until a replacement is issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you brought your licence and also want to ask how to withdraw cash after blocking the card and before receiving a replacement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通帳や書類で確認する条件を、担当に尋ねてください。再発行の費用と日数も一緒に聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the person in charge about the conditions for checks using your passbook and documents. You can also ask about replacement fees and how many days it takes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通帳と免許証を担当へ見せます。まず停止、そのあと再発行の費用と日数、現金の引き出し方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通帳と免許証を担当へ示し停止後に再発行費用日数と引出方法を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the person in charge my passbook and licence. First I will ask for the card to be blocked, then ask about replacement costs and timing, and how to withdraw cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show your passbook and licence and, after blocking, ask about replacement fees, days required, and cash withdrawals. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当は隣の窓口です。こちらから用件を伝えますのでお進みください。それでは、ここで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The person in charge is at the next counter. I will explain your request, so please go ahead. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: タイマーをお持ちですね。どのような不具合でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a timer. What seems to be wrong with it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日ここで買いました。時間を合わせると表示されますが、スタートを押すと画面が消えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入したタイマーが設定表示後スタートで画面消失すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought it here yesterday. The time appears when I set it, but when I press Start, the screen goes blank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the timer bought yesterday displays the setting but its screen goes blank when you press Start. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 電池は付属の物をお使いですか。説明書にある最初の設定も確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you using the supplied battery? Have you checked the initial setup in the instructions as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 付属の電池です。説明書どおりに設定しました。電池は交換せず、ふたを開けて確かめただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 付属電池と説明書どおりの設定で電池交換はせずふたを開けただけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the supplied battery. I set it up as instructed. I have not changed the battery; I only opened the cover to check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you used the supplied battery and followed the instructions, and only opened the cover without changing the battery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 試した範囲がわかりました。購入を確認するレシートと、説明書もお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I understand what you have tried. Have you also brought the receipt to confirm your purchase, and the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートと説明書、箱もあります。不具合が出たときの画面を動画に撮ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートと説明書と箱を持ち不具合動画もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the receipt, instructions, and box. I also filmed the screen when the fault occurred.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you brought the receipt, instructions, and box, and have a video of the fault. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで確認する参考になります。商品と動画を担当に見てもらいますので、ご希望の対応も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That will help us check it. I will have the person in charge look at the product and video. Could you tell me what outcome you would prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 料理の時間を測りたいので、正常に動く物と交換できるか確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理時間用に正常動作品との交換可否の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to time my cooking, so please check whether I can exchange it for one that works properly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a check on exchanging it for a working timer to time cooking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 交換の希望を担当へ伝えます。今ここで決定はできませんので、商品を預けて確認を待っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge that you would like an exchange. I cannot decide here right now. Could you leave the product with us and wait for the check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱と説明書を含めて預けます。動画は自分の携帯に残して、担当者に見せられるようにしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品一式を預け動画を携帯に保持して担当に示す準備をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave it, including the box and instructions. I will keep the video on my phone so I can show it to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the complete product set and keep the video on your phone ready to show the staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認が終わったら対応をご説明します。担当を呼んできますので、それでは一度失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will explain the response once the check is complete. I will go and call the person in charge. Excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その先は通路の作業中です。柵の手前でお待ちください。どちらへ向かっていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Work is being carried out on the path ahead. Please wait on this side of the barrier. Where were you heading?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 東の入口へ戻りたいです。一周すれば戻れると思って歩いてきましたが、ここは通れないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一周して東入口へ戻る予定だったが通路閉鎖で進めないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to return to the east entrance. I came this way thinking a full circuit would take me back, but I cannot pass here, can I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm that you intended to return to the east entrance by going around, but cannot continue because the path is closed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、今日はここから先へは進めません。東の入口へは、来た道を戻る方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is right; you cannot go any farther here today. You can return to the east entrance by retracing your route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来た道には坂があって疲れました。遠回りでも、坂の少ない戻り道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来た道の坂で疲れたため遠回りでも坂の少ない戻り道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The path I came along had slopes, and I got tired. Is there a way back with fewer slopes, even if it is a detour?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the slopes on the way here tired you and ask for a return route with fewer slopes, even if longer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図の南側の道なら坂が少ないですが、来た道より距離があります。入口へ向かう前に休憩されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The path on the south side of this map has fewer slopes, but it is longer than the route you came on. Would you like a rest before heading for the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し休みたいです。この近くにベンチはありますか。柵の前には座らない方がいいですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩希望を伝え近くのベンチと柵前を避けることを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to rest a little. Is there a bench nearby? I should not sit in front of the barrier, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to rest, ask about a nearby bench, and confirm you should avoid sitting in front of the barrier. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 柵の前は作業の通路です。あちらの休憩スペースにベンチがありますので、そこでお休みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The area in front of the barrier is an access route for the work. There are benches in the rest area over there, so please rest there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休んでから南側の道を選びます。途中の分かれ道で東の入口がわかる表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩後南側へ進むと伝え分岐の東入口表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: After resting, I will take the southern path. Are there signs at the forks showing the east entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take the southern path after resting and ask about east-entrance signs at the forks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かれ道に東入口の矢印があります。図で休憩スペースからの道も確認してから出発してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are arrows for the east entrance at the forks. Please also check the route from the rest area on the map before setting off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先にベンチで休み、図を見て南側の道へ進みます。分かれ道では東入口の矢印を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベンチ休憩と図の確認後南側へ進み東入口の矢印を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest on a bench first, check the map, and then take the southern path. At the forks, I will check the arrows for the east entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rest on the bench, check the map, then take the southern path and follow the east-entrance arrows. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理をせず、また迷ったら係員へお声がけください。それでは、気をつけてお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do not overdo it, and ask a member of staff if you lose your way again. Take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の画面を選んだところで止まっていますね。購入前に確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped after making a selection on the ticket machine screen. Is there anything you want to check before buying?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じような駅名が二つ出ています。会社でもらった紙と合っているか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似た駅名二つを会社の紙と照合してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two similar station names are shown. Please check them against this paper my company gave me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the two similar station names with the paper from your company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙を拝見します。「川」の字が入っている方ですね。今の画面では別の駅が選ばれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the paper. You need the one with the character 「川」 in it. A different station is currently selected on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだお金は入れていません。この選択を取り消して、最初から選び直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未入金であると伝え誤選択を取り消して選び直せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not put any money in yet. Can I cancel this selection and choose again from the beginning?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not inserted money and ask whether you can cancel the wrong choice and select again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この戻るボタンで行き先の選択画面へ戻れます。いったん一緒に戻しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, this Back button takes you back to the destination selection screen. Let us go back together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻れました。紙の駅名にある「川」の字を確かめてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 戻った画面で紙の駅名の川の字を確認して選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has gone back. I will check for the character 「川」 in the station name on the paper before selecting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the character 「川」 in the station name on the paper and select it on the restored screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その駅で合っています。出発日は本日になっていますが、ご予定と一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is the right station. The departure date is set to today; does that match your plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社へ行くのは明日です。今日は下見だけなので、今は切符を買わないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際の乗車は明日で今日は下見のため購入を中止すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am going to the company tomorrow. Today I am only checking the route, so I will not buy a ticket now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your actual journey is tomorrow and you are only checking today, so you will stop the purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では購入を中止しましょう。画面を初めに戻します。明日は日付も確認してからお買い求めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us cancel the purchase. I will return the screen to the beginning. Tomorrow, please check the date too before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行き先と日付を先に確認します。今日は買わず、この紙を持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行き先と日付を確認して今日は買わず紙を持ち帰ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the destination and date first. I will not buy today and will take this paper home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the destination and date, buy nothing today, and take the paper home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ええ、画面は戻りました。紙をお忘れにならないように。明日もお気をつけて、さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, the screen is back at the beginning. Please do not forget your paper. Take care tomorrow too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請画面をお持ちとのことですね。今表示されている文言を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an application screen with you, I understand. Could you tell me the wording currently displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 画面に「一時保存」と出ています。昨日入力しましたが、市役所へ送れたのか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一時保存表示があり昨日入力したが送信成功が不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The screen says "Temporarily saved." I entered the information yesterday, but I am not sure it was sent to city hall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the screen shows a temporary save and you entered it yesterday but do not know whether sending succeeded. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一時保存の画面だけでは受付済みと判断できません。完了の通知や受付番号は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: A temporary-save screen alone does not prove the application has been received. Have you received a completion notification or application number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通知は届いていません。受付番号も見つからないので、同じ内容をもう一度送ろうか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知と受付番号がなく再送信すべきか迷っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not received a notification, and I cannot find an application number. I am wondering whether to send the same details again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have no notification or application number and are unsure whether to submit again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二重になるのを避けるため、まず申請を扱う担当で状況を確認しましょう。申請したい手続きの名前はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: To avoid duplicates, let us first check the status with the department handling the application. Do you know the name of the procedure you want to apply for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この上に書かれた「施設利用申込み」です。利用したい日は今週の土曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請名が施設利用申込みで希望日が今週土曜だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says "Application to use a facility" up here. I want to use it this Saturday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the application name as "Application to use a facility" and the desired date as this Saturday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 施設の担当へ確認します。まだ受付が済んでいない場合の操作も、担当からご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check with the facility staff. They will also explain what to do if your application has not yet been received.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 利用日が近いことも伝えてください。確認前に予約できたと家族へ言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用日が近いことの伝達を頼み家族へ予約済みと言わず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please also tell them the date is soon. I will avoid telling my family the reservation is confirmed before the check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to mention the approaching date, and say you will wait without telling your family the reservation is confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がこちらで画面を確認することになりました。個人情報の画面は周囲に見せず、私と一緒に担当窓口へ行きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check your screen here. Do not show screens with personal information to people around you; let us go together to the responsible counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再送信せずに、担当の方に保存画面を見てもらいます。受付と予約の状況を確認してから家族へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再送せず担当が画面確認し受付予約状況がわかってから家族へ連絡すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not send it again and will have the staff look at the saved screen. I will contact my family after checking the application and reservation status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will not resubmit, will have the staff check the screen, and will tell your family after learning the receipt and reservation status. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは担当へおつなぎします。こちらの相談はこれで終わります。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person in charge now. This concludes our consultation here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票に、呼び出しが聞き取りにくいと書かれていますね。どのようにお呼びすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You wrote on the medical questionnaire that it is hard to hear when you are called. How would you like us to call you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左耳が聞こえにくいので、右側から話しかけてください。大きな声より、近くでゆっくり話してもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左耳が聞こえにくいため右側から近くでゆっくり話してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot hear well in my left ear, so please speak from my right side. It would help if you came close and spoke slowly rather than loudly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difficulty hearing in your left ear and ask to be spoken to slowly from nearby on your right side. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 右側から、近くでゆっくりですね。診察する医師にもお伝えします。聞き取りにくさはいつからでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: From your right, nearby and slowly. I will tell the doctor who examines you too. How long have you had difficulty hearing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 数か月前からです。急に悪くなったわけではありませんが、最近テレビの音を上げることが増えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数か月続き急変ではないがテレビ音量を上げることが増えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: For a few months. It has not suddenly become worse, but recently I have been turning up the television more often.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it has lasted several months with no sudden change, but you more often turn up the television volume. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過も医師へ伝えます。説明の途中でわからなかったときは、遠慮せず聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the doctor that history as well. If you do not understand something during an explanation, please feel free to ask again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞き返しても聞き取れない場合は、薬の名前や次の予定を紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 聞き返しても難しい場合に薬名と次の予定を書いてほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I still cannot hear after asking again, could you write down the names of medicines and my next appointment or plans?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for medicine names and the next schedule to be written down if you still cannot hear after asking again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な内容は書いて確認できるようにします。待合では、番号を呼んだ後にこちらから近くへ伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will write down what is necessary so you can check it. In the waiting room, would you like us to come close to you after calling your number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。案内表示が見える席に座りますので、その席まで来ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内表示が見える席へ直接呼びに来てほしいと求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I will sit where I can see the information display, so please come to that seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to come directly to your seat where the information display is visible to call you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、表示の正面の椅子にお座りください。お呼びするときは右側からお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please sit on the chair facing the display. We will speak from your right side when we call you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示の正面で待ちます。診察でもわからない所を聞き返して、重要な内容は書いて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定席で待ち診察で聞き返し重要事項を書いて確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait facing the display. During the examination too, I will ask again about anything unclear and check important information in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait in the designated seat, ask again during the examination, and check important points in writing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちの間に困ったことがあれば、この受付へお知らせください。それでは、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-35211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: If you have any difficulty while waiting, please tell this reception desk. Excuse me for now.
